text:
maria: Canary rollout for reconnect rate limiter showing client disconnect spike in eu-west. Console SLO panel flagged it.
jon: I see that. Console groups server throttle and client backoff so it's confusing. Client logs show edge `429` then immediate retry.
kevin: could be client-side tight retry loop exhausting a short budget.
olivia: raw edge sample: `edge: conn=abc123 429 quota_exceeded route=eu-west1` then `client: retry 1` then `edge: conn=abc123 204 resume_no_session`.
maria: Proposal: split Console metric into `429_from_edge` vs `client_backoff` and bump reconnect trace sampling for the canary to 10%.
jon: also annotate canary routes in Console so SREs see expected noise.
kevin: implementation note: metrics pipeline currently double-counts because resume translates 429->204 later. We should dedupe by session_id.
olivia: resume events don't include session_id in observability today.
maria: can we add it? Performance hit?
kevin: small schema bump on metrics flush, low risk. I'll handle it.
sre-bot: deploybot: Canary reconnect-rate-limiter v2 -> 23% complete.
jon: action items: kevin bump sampling + add session_id, maria + product split metric and RFC, olivia annotate canary. If ratio >0.2 after changes, rollback.
maria: repro tip: `curl -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\"` + `--limit-rate` mimics timing. Watch client TTL; reconnects within 2s can thrash quota.
jon: go ahead with the sampling bump behind a feature flag.
kevin: doing it now.
maria: thanks — will draft Console RFC and sync tomorrow.
